Our connections01 / 04
Yiwu, China

Yiwu Barq Trading & CO., LTD

Yiwu Barq Trading & CO., LTD is Barq Cargo's sister company based in Yiwu, China — the world's largest small-commodity market. We provide comprehensive warehousing and export services, enabling Pakistani importers to source, store, consolidate, and export goods from China seamlessly.

  • Strategic warehousing in Yiwu, Shanghai, and Guangzhou
  • Goods receiving, inspection, and labelling in China
  • Cargo consolidation for cost-effective FCL/LCL exports to Pakistan
  • Direct export corridors: China → Karachi Port & Port Qasim
  • Procurement assistance and supplier coordination
  • Real-time inventory visibility with digital reporting
Discuss your requirements
Pakistan

Vector Logistics

Vector Logistics is a full-service logistics provider operating in parallel to Barq Cargo. Sharing the same ethos of reliability and speed, Vector extends the group's collective freight capabilities — offering ground, air, and ocean services to a broader clientele across Pakistan and international trade corridors.

  • Multi-modal freight services: road, air, and ocean
  • Domestic and cross-border distribution network
  • Dedicated account management for key clients
  • Integrated operations with Barq Cargo for seamless joint shipments
  • Warehousing and distribution in major Pakistani cities
  • 24/7 operations support and real-time cargo tracking
Discuss your requirements
United States

Elite Prepware

Elite Prepware operates professional warehousing and fulfilment facilities across the United States. Specializing in e-commerce prep services, Amazon FBA preparation, and retail distribution, Elite Prepware enables Pakistani and international sellers to establish a reliable US logistics footprint without the overhead of owning local infrastructure.

  • Amazon FBA prep: labelling, bundling, poly-bagging, and box-building
  • Multi-warehouse network across key US logistics hubs
  • Receiving, inspection, and storage of imported goods
  • B2B and B2C retail fulfilment services
  • Returns management and reverse logistics
  • Real-time inventory dashboard for all stored SKUs
